label: Stop tagged runs
description: Stop every run of this project carrying a tag, parked runs included (they never resume). Each wired input is a tag, normalized exactly as TagRun does. Put a TagRun first: a stop only reaches runs tagged before this one, so runs arriving together do not stop each other.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Tags as one list; added to the wired inputs.

inputs.name: includeSelf
inputs.label: Stop this run too
inputs.description: Off: stop the other runs carrying the tag and keep this one. On: stop every run carrying the tag, this one included; this run ends cancelled the same way `weft stop` ends one.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the stop is queued.
